title: Synthetic device identity
description: Validate lichen_hal_synthetic_device_identity_allowed() and lichen_hal_synthetic_device_identity_get() for native_sim and test builds. Ensure production builds reject synthetic identity.
close_reason: Added 5 unit tests to lichen/tests/hal/src/main.c validating synthetic device identity functions: allowed check returns true on native_sim/false on production, get returns valid non-zero ID, null pointer rejection, small buffer rejection, production build rejection
